blocks.prompt: Leo's hook: is it legal, and if not, what fails?
Mia's multi-part hook: is it legal, and if not, what fails?

criteria.text: Judges two unfamiliar hooks against the rules

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Leo: the top hole (0.875 in is under 1.000 in). Mia: opening it takes too long (30 s, and a tool, against 10 s by hand).

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the two picks is right.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Neither pick is right, or none is made.

blocks.prompt: Two ideas borrowed: where from, the idea, and why it holds more load
The 3D feature your hook will use
Where on your hook it goes, and why there

criteria.text: Two borrowed ideas, each specific and tied to where the load goes

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Two ideas from two different sources. Each row names one specific feature and says how it handles the load.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both rows name a specific feature, but one reason is general ("it held a lot").

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The ideas are described in general terms, or only one row is filled.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: The table is empty, or both rows come from the same design.

criteria.text: A 3D feature is picked, placed on the hook, and justified

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A feature is picked, and the line says where on the hook it goes and why there.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A feature is picked, but the line gives no place or no reason.

blocks.prompt: Photo of your two concept sketches
A second sketch photo, if you have one
Sketch A: the idea in one line, and what is 3D about it
Sketch B: the idea in one line, and what is 3D about it
Stretch: a key joint sketched to fit your hook

criteria.text: Two readable sketches of two different hooks, with a 3D feature shown

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Two readable sketches of two genuinely different hooks, and at least one shows a 3D feature in a side view, a section or shading.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Two sketches, but they are the same hook redrawn, or neither shows anything beyond a flat outline.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one sketch is in the photo, or one cannot be read.

criteria.text: Each sketch is typed and its idea stated in one line

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both sketches are marked standard or multi-part, and each line states the idea and its 3D feature.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both lines are there, but one could describe any hook.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one sketch is typed and stated.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Neither sketch is typed or stated.
